evidence: Method: built a criterion -> public-requirement map for all 52 criteria (2 gates, 41 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual likert) against instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md, then looked for exact labels, routes, layouts, statuses or golden-only rules. No criterion demands an exact route, selector, label, layout or wording; app_context.md:37-38 and functional prompt.md:15 explicitly forbid assuming them, and status codes graded in hro_refusal_status/hro_anonymous (401/403/404/409) are each stated in hireops_rules.md:22-24 and :80. Every stricter leg traces to a brief sentence, e.g.: places 0/51/2.5 refused (rules:29 'whole number from 1 to 50'); manager picked from manager accounts (rules:29-30); email at field and typed text kept (rules:35-36); skip refused (rules:48-49); blank reason refused and rejected-from stage visible to staff (rules:49-51); reopen only to rejected-from stage and undo restoring the reason (rules:50-51, :99); arrive-at-bottom and bulk board order Y,W,X / A2,V (rules:58, :92-93); focus kept on the refused card (rules:85-87); stale 409 naming who (rules:78-81); bulk all-or-none and set-wide places (rules:93-94); undo blocked by move/re-order/reject/reopen of those cards, undo-once and superseded earlier move (rules:98-103) - hro_undo_once's 'Z stays in Screen' matches 'once I make a later move, my earlier one is no longer undoable'; manager early-stage/Applied re-order/Screen reopen/open-job/add-candidate refusals (rules:17-18, 28-33, 71-74); Activity lines incl. each undo and re-ordering, newest first, job filter, refusals leave no line (rules:113-117), with notes/messages explicitly exempted in hro_activity; message plain text, Enter/Shift+Enter, cleared+focused box, failed send kept and explained (rules:143-145); 30-message window, remaining count, anchored top message (rules:149-152); scrolled-up notice with count (rules:164-165); per-person unread and live updates (rules:121-123, 156-159); seen rules incl. observer never counts (rules:169-171); drafts per conversation/browser, across reload and session end, private to others (rules:175-180; instruction.md:7); note drafts kept 'for me on that browser until I do' (rules:108-109); candidate wording, no internal data/positions/activity, 404 for other applications (rules:184-200); live-update preservation of typing, focus, open card/conversation and scroll (rules:125-127; instruction.md:5); restart durability and seed-once (instruction.md:17). Sign-in legs (gates and many rows) are the documented house-convention false positive (SKILL.md Known false positives; workbook Internal Quality Checks row 28). Visual likert rows grade only professional-default craft and explicitly say 'Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice' and 'No phone layout or theme switching is required' (visual prompt.md:14), consistent with instruction.md:11. Lessons file lesson 1 (no hidden/golden-only demands) checked for every criterion leg: none found that lacks a brief sentence. Seed check: Lena Fischer (USR-CAN3) has read marker read_count 2 on APP-301 whose 3rd message is from USR-REC3, so 'starts with 1 unread' (functional prompt.md:33) follows from the stated marker rule (rules:213-214), not from golden behaviour. Hash check: raw-evidence-index artifacts and their matching_source_files all equal the frozen bytes; that index is scripted golden evidence only, not a configured judge run, so it neither proves nor disproves an Oracle false-fail. RESIDUAL (why Note with risk=true): three legs rest on an inferred rather than literal public sentence. (1) hro_unread_counts (weight 2) opens with 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread on her conversation' read on the CANDIDATE's page (functional prompt.md:33). The display sentence is staff-voiced: rules:159 'We see the unread count for each conversation and one total for ourselves', and the candidate view in rules:184-186 enumerates title, team, status and the conversation with no unread count. The requirement is derivable from instruction.md:7 'Unread counts need to be right for each person' and rules:156 'For each person, ...', and the golden shows candidate badges (threads.js:55-57, :221), so I judge it stated, but a builder reading section 7 as the full candidate surface could omit candidate badges and lose the whole weight-2 row. (2) hro_seen requires 'Tomas's later message shows as seen on his page' (candidate page). Implied by rules:170-171 (a candidate's message is seen once a recruiter/that job's manager has), which only has a consumer on the candidate page; instruction.md:7 states only the staff side. Lower exposure. (3) hro_pol_session_resume fails if 'Mei sees either of Rafael's drafts' including the unsaved NOTE draft; explicit other-user privacy (rules:179, instruction.md:7) is written for replies only, the note-draft rule says 'keep it for me on that browser until I do' (rules:108-109). 'for me' supports per-person keying; low exposure. Minor protocol latitude, not an unrequired demand: B(12) asks Mei to 're-order a different J2 card (Y) within its stage' without bounding the direction; in the scripted order Screen is Y,W,X,Z,A2, so an up/down control can only move Y down one place and A2's place is untouched, but a drag that drops Y below A2 would shift A2's place and could let an app that versions every card whose place shifts refuse the undo; rules:100 only names 'those cards', so the criterion's expectation is the stated reading.
counterexample: Conforming-reading alternative: an app whose candidate page lists each application with title, team, candidate wording and its conversation exactly as rules:184-186 enumerates, with per-person unread counts computed and shown to staff (rules:159 'We see ... for ourselves') but no unread badge on the candidate page. At protocol Z the judge reads no count for Lena where it expects 1, and hro_unread_counts ('Fails if any count is wrong') scores 0 for weight 2 even though every staff-side unread behaviour is correct. Likewise an app showing seen marks only on staff messages loses hro_seen (1.5). No plausible broken app was found that passes by exploiting an unrequired demand; a broken app that shows no candidate counts fails as intended under the per-person reading.
suggested_fix: Add one requester-voice clause to hireops_rules.md section 7 (e.g. 'Candidates get the same unread count and seen mark on their own conversations that we do') and, optionally, 'my unsaved note is mine too' beside rules:108-109 and 'one place up or down' in functional B(12); no criterion change needed.
